mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS owner_nickname, sp.user_id AS source_owner_id, su.nickname AS source_owner_nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist c WHERE c.source_playlist_id = p.id) AS collect_count FROM playlist p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN playlist sp ON sp.id = p.source_playlist_id LEFT JOIN users su ON su.id = sp.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlist (user_id, title, description, total_duration, is_public, listen_minutes) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{totalDuration}, #{isPublic}, #{listenMinutes})

INSERT INTO playlist (user_id, title, description, title_en, description_en, total_duration, is_public, listen_minutes, source_playlist_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{titleEn}, #{descriptionEn}, #{totalDuration}, #{isPublic}, #{listenMinutes}, #{sourcePlaylistId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, source_playlist_id) WHERE source_playlist_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE playlist SET is_hidden = #{hidden} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE playlist SET is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE playlist SET title = CASE WHEN #{title} = title_en THEN title ELSE #{title} END, title_en = CASE WHEN #{title} = title_en OR #{title} = title THEN title_en ELSE NULL END, description = CASE WHEN #{description} = description_en THEN description ELSE #{description} END, description_en = CASE WHEN #{description} = description_en OR #{description} = description THEN description_en ELSE NULL END, total_duration = #{totalDuration}, is_public = #{isPublic}, listen_minutes = #{listenMinutes} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT recent.recent_plays, x.* FROM (
WHERE p.is_public = true AND p.is_hidden = false ) x JOIN ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS recent_plays FROM play_log WHERE target_type = 'PLAYLIST' AND played_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days}) GROUP BY target_id ) recent ON recent.target_id = x.id ORDER BY recent.recent_plays DESC, x.play_count DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
WHERE p.is_public = true AND p.is_hidden = false AND p.id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist WHERE is_public = true AND is_hidden = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlist_layer (playlist_id, role, volume) VALUES (#{playlistId}, #{role}, #{volume})

INSERT INTO playlist_block (layer_id, block_id, sort_order, repeat_count, start_seconds) VALUES
(#{layerId}, #{item.blockId}, #{i} + 1, #{item.repeat}, #{item.startSeconds})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS layer_id, l.playlist_id, l.role, l.volume, pb.id AS pb_id, pb.block_id, pb.sort_order, pb.repeat_count, pb.start_seconds, b.title AS block_title, b.title_en AS block_title_en, b.file_key, b.duration AS block_duration, b.price AS block_price, b.status AS block_status, b.is_active AS block_active, b.thumbnail_key AS block_cover, b.stickers AS block_stickers, b.sticker_pattern AS block_pattern, b.video_key AS block_video, b.uploader_id AS block_uploader_id, c.id AS cat_id, c.name AS cat_name, c.name_en AS cat_name_en, c.code AS cat_code, c.color AS cat_color, c.icon AS cat_icon, c.parent_id AS cat_parent_id, pc.name AS cat_parent_name, pc.name_en AS cat_parent_name_en, pc.code AS cat_parent_code FROM playlist_layer l JOIN playlist_block pb ON pb.layer_id = l.id JOIN block b ON b.id = pb.block_id LEFT JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN sound_category pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id WHERE l.playlist_id IN #{id} ORDER BY l.playlist_id, l.role, COALESCE(pb.start_seconds, 0), pb.sort_order
mapper.update: UPDATE playlist SET play_count = play_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
